evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/runelite/a/a is an interface with exactly six abstract int getters and no unrelated methods; rs/a/i is its six-int concrete model-bounds implementation.
The only recovered concrete implementation is populated by Model from three axis centers and three half-extents and cached by orientation, directly binding the interface to axis-aligned model bounds.

RuneLite upstream commit 5dffa0133efcf32e5e0c7e488dbf24ef5f781630 introduced net.runelite.api.AABB as an interface with exactly getCenterX(), getCenterY(), getCenterZ(), getExtremeX(), getExtremeY() and getExtremeZ(), matching the six-method exact-v308 interface.

proposals.note: AABB is recovered at confidence 0.999 as an upstream source-name match for the exact six-getter RuneLite API interface. Corrected R32 now names the concrete rs/a/i implementation ModelAABB, avoiding a duplicate and preserving the source-proven noun for this interface.
